This notebook is mainly going to serve as a proof on concept for how to use 311 data on a unified project.
should 

## Research Question:
  - How do 311 complaints distribute throughout NY?
    - Borough, Building Type, ZIP, City could all be faceted across
  - Want to create a tool where a user could enter their zip, borough, etc.  
  - Start with Rats and Pests, expand from there
  


## Importing libs

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nycOpenData)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load in Data 

```{r}
sample_311 = nyc_any_dataset(json_link = 'https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.json')
```

## Columns that we want
-

```{r}
colnames(sample_311)
```


## EDA

### common complaints, descriptors, and locations

```{r}
complaints = sample_311 |> count(complaint_type, sort = TRUE) # Types of complaints that can show up across
descriptors = sample_311 |> count(descriptor, sort = TRUE)
locations = sample_311 |> count(location_type, sort = TRUE)
# borough column may also be of interest
```


### Unsanitary Condition descriptors

```{r}
sample_311 |>
  filter(
    complaint_type == "UNSANITARY CONDITION"
  ) |>
  count(descriptor, sort = TRUE)
  
```

```{r}
glimpse(sample_311)

```
